text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I've sent Dana the list in their DM. I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines (QFL) ticket numbers across Moss's six public notes:

- **#PD-4492**, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (2025-10-05). Drivers at the Eau Claire yard's gatehouse kiosk weren't getting SMS bay assignments. Support patched it on 4 Oct 2025, and the customer confirmed the fix the next day.
- **#4419**, from "Moss: North cheat sheet", which has no date. The gatehouse barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14, and the ticket was escalated to tier-2 support.

The other two notes that mention QFL contain no ticket numbers. The Central team notes do list FR-882, #4409 and #4412, but those belong to Marrow accounts, so I left them out.

I told Dana I only checked Moss's public notes, so there may be other QFL tickets elsewhere. I didn't look through the QFL incident channel, the North team channel or any account ticket files.
